normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 34E On the Gulf” at High Pointe Resort, located in Seacrest Beach. Wake up to stunning gulf views, sip coffee on the balcony with the ocean breeze, and unwind by the lagoon-style pool or hot tub. Steps from private beach access, this serene escape is perfect for families or groups of 6 seeking laid-back luxury. Dive into the ultimate coastal vibe with cozy spaces and everything you need for a memorable stay. Ready to soak it all in? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Balcony with Stunning Views And Loungers for the Ultimate Relaxation – Experience pure serenity as you sip your morning coffee or watch the sunset from a private balcony with breathtaking ocean views, complete with comfortable loungers made for unwinding.Access to a Lagoon-Style Pool with a Waterfall Feature, Hot Tub, and Kiddie Pool – Dive into paradise with a resort-style pool designed for everyone—relax by the soothing waterfall, soak in the hot tub, or let the kids splash in their own dedicated pool area.Spacious Primary Suite with Private Beachfront Access and Luxurious En-Suite Bathroom – Indulge in ultimate comfort with a private suite that opens directly to the beach, paired with a spa-like en-suite bathroom for a truly rejuvenating stay.Central Location Near Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Local Shops and Restaurants – Immerse yourself in the vibrant coastal lifestyle with nearby charming towns, boutique shopping, and dining options just minutes away.Beach Chair Setup Provided Seasonally (March - October) – Relax effortlessly with complimentary beach chairs waiting for you, so you can sit back, soak up the sun, and enjoy the white-sand shores stress-free.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The balcony views of the Gulf were absolutely breathtaking! From sunrise to sunset, this condo provided the perfect beach escape. Everything was flawless, and we can't wait to return!" – Michelle⭐"Amazing location! Just steps away from the beach, pool, and local shops. The setup was ideal for our family, especially with little ones. It made our vacation so easy and enjoyable!" – Kaila⭐"This property is truly stunning! Beautifully designed and wonderfully cozy. The peaceful atmosphere made it a dream getaway. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a relaxing retreat!" – Anne*** LIVING AREA ***Immerse yourself in serene coastal luxury as the open-concept living area welcomes you with sweeping, unobstructed Gulf views. Gentle, beach-inspired hues blend seamlessly with plush, inviting furnishings, crafting a tranquil retreat where relaxation takes center stage. Whether you're unwinding with a movie on the large flat-screen TV or sharing meaningful moments against the stunning backdrop of a golden sunset, this space is thoughtfully designed to elevate comfort, connection, and pure coastal bliss.Stunning open-concept design bathed in natural light with breathtaking Gulf viewsExpansive beachfront balcony, featuring a dining table for 4 and cozy seating for 2, perfect for relaxing or enjoying meals with a viewOversized flat-screen TV and luxurious, plush seating designed for ultimate comfort and entertainment*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whip up your favorite meals in the fully updated kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and everything you need for effortless culinary creations. Savor your meals at the dining table with seating for 6, or step outside and dine al fresco on the beachside balcony as waves provide the soundtrack.Modern, fully equipped kitchen featuring premium stainless steel appliancesAn elegant and spacious dining table designed to comfortably seat up to 6 guests, complemented by additional seating for 3 at the stylish breakfast bar—perfect for entertaining or family gatheringsStunning granite countertops with plenty of prep space for all your culinary creationsIn-unit washer and dryer for added convenience*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***Featuring exquisitely designed bedrooms adorned with plush furnishings and spa-inspired bathrooms, this space seamlessly blends luxury and serenity for an unmatched relaxation experience.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: 2 Queen Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hall access. *** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort is a tropical paradise offering everything you need for the ultimate vacation. From the expansive community pool with a waterfall to a Gulf-front bar and grill, the amenities are abundant and designed to make your stay unforgettable.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Situated perfectly between the charming Rosemary Beach and the luxurious Alys Beach, this condo delivers the quintessential 30A lifestyle. Stroll through boutique shops, savor exquisite cuisine at celebrated local restaurants, or relax on breathtaking sugar-white beaches—all just moments from your doorstep. Experience coastal living at its finest!Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 204342
